I told Ilse in our DM that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30, which is what she told me on Oct 14.

I got that from her own message in the DM, not from gbrain. When I looked up the private note I saved, it didn't come back, probably because lookups over this connection only return notes visible to everyone. So private notes saved this way may not be retrievable later, and the DM history is the reliable record for now.
